breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses ICHARG=0 instead of ICHARG=11, matching the ground truth. It explicitly notes 'Do not include ICHARG=11 from the raw block; use ICHARG=0 as confirmed,' which aligns with the requirement that ICHARG cannot exceed 10 so the charge density is recomputed during the HSE calculation.
